description: Count down to the next New Year (midnight at the start of 1 January): days, hours, minutes, seconds and sleeps remaining, plus the weekday New Year's Day falls on. Uses the current time by default, or an optional 'from' date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO date-time, in which case everything is worked out in UTC. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/new-year-countdown/

from.description: Optional moment to count from: YYYY-MM-DD (taken as 00:00 UTC) or a full ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-12-31T18:30:00Z. Defaults to now.

name: hopi_new_year_countdown
title: New Year countdown
